L32@P1: About the PlayStation®2 console documentation
L33@P1: The PlayStation®2 console documentation includes the following:
L34@P1: • Quick Reference
L35@P1: A manual that is included in the package with the console. It contains information on
L36@P1: setting up and performing basic operations on the console, as well as safety and
L37@P1: troubleshooting information.
L38@P1: • User's Guide (this document)
L39@P1: This document (in PDF format) is accessed from a PC through the Internet and
L40@P1: contains information on performing advanced operations on the console, technical
L41@P1: specifications and other information. You can download this document from the
L42@P1: support page on the Sony Computer Entertainment Web site.
L43@P1: United Kingdom: uk.playstation.com/manuals
L44@P1: Australia: au.playstation.com/manuals
L45@P1: New Zealand: nz.playstation.com/manuals
L46@P1-2: Table of contentsGetting started 3 Preparation
L47@P2: You can place the console in either the horizontal or vertical position.
L48@P2: Horizontal position
L49@P2: Set the console horizontally.
L50@P2: Vertical position
L51@P2: When setting the console in the vertical
L52@P2: position, use the SCPH-90110 E Vertical
L53@P2: Stand (for PlayStation®2) (sold separately).
L54@P2: Hint
L55@P2: Some Vertical Stands (for PlayStation®2) cannot be used with this model of the
L56@P2: PlayStation®2 console. For details, see the Quick Reference manual ( page 2).
L57@P2: Choose the SCPH-90110 E when purchasing a Vertical Stand.
L58@P2: Caution
L59@P2: Do not place the console in locations where it may be exposed to the following
L60@P2: conditions:
L61@P2: • Places subject to excessive cigarette smoke or dust. Cigarette smoke residue
L62@P2: or dust build-up on the internal components, such as the lens, may cause the
L63@P2: console to malfunction.
L64@P2: • Places subject to extreme temperatures, in direct sunlight, near a heat source,
L65@P2: or in a car with its windows closed (particularly in summer). These conditions
L66@P2: may warp the exterior of the console or cause the console to malfunction.
L67@P2: • Places close to magnetic fields, such as those produced by magnets or
L68@P2: loudspeakers.
L69@P2: • Places subject to vibration.
